color-system.twistDescription: No twist — copied verbatim. Source pageBackground #f2f2f2 (luminance 242) qualifies as light register.

type-system.twistDescription: Twist B intensity 3: Added --font-letter-spacing-heading: 0.06em CSS variable; applied letterSpacing: 0.06em to h2 and button typeScale entries. All fonts (Figtree, Nunito, Quicksand) are Google Fonts — replaced with CDN @import blocks.

motion-system.twistDescription: Twist A intensity 2: All transition durations scaled by 1.3x (0.8s → 1.04s) for a more measured, unhurried pacing.

grid-system.twistDescription: Twist A intensity 2: Container maxWidth reduced from 1436px to 1220px (15% reduction) — increases lateral margin pressure, creates a more editorial reading column.

spacing-system.twistDescription: Twist C intensity 3: Hero padding scaled by 1.5x (paddingTop: 139px → 209px, paddingBottom: 60px → 90px). All other spacing unchanged.

interaction-states.twistDescription: Twist A intensity 2: All hover transition durations increased by +0.05s (0.7s → 0.75s) for a more languid interaction register.

nav-system.twistDescription: Twist E intensity 3: itemSpacing increased from 49px to 59px (+10px) — creates more generous breathing room between navigation link items.

concept-summary.twistDescription: Twist C (material shift): Rewrote the color register paragraph to foreground the material texture of the cool off-white surface (#f2f2f2) as analogous to matte-coated paper or machined surfaces — precision rather than warmth. Generated full concept_by_video.md with 3 video placements.
